heading: Electronic stamp requirements; recognition of electronic stamp

tree.heading: Stamp requirements
tree.text: The Secretary shall require an electronic stamp issued by a State under this subchapter—

children.text: to have the same format as any other license, validation, or privilege the State issues under the automated licensing system of the State; and
to specify identifying features of the licensee that are adequate to enable Federal, State, and other law enforcement officers to identify the holder.

tree.heading: Recognition of electronic stamp
tree.text: Any electronic stamp issued by a State under this subchapter shall—

children.text: bestow upon the licensee the same privileges as are bestowed by an actual stamp;
be recognized nationally as a valid Federal migratory bird hunting and conservation stamp; and
authorize the licensee to hunt migratory waterfowl in any other State, in accordance with the laws of the other State governing that hunting.

tree.heading: Duration
tree.text: An electronic stamp issued by a State shall be valid through the first June 30 that occurs after the date of issuance of the electronic stamp by the State.

notes.text: Amendments2023—Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 118–25, § 2(c)(1), substituted “shall—” for “shall, during the effective period of the electronic stamp—” in introductory provisions. Subsec. (c). Pub. L. 118–25, § 2(c)(2), substituted “through the first June 30 that occurs after the date of issuance of the electronic stamp by the State” for “for a period agreed to by the State and the Secretary, which shall not exceed 45 days”.
